steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Bohemian Rhapsody has six distinct sections: intro-ballad-guitar solo-opera-rock-outro — each with different musical elements creating dramatic contrast. | Key Fact: Queen's vocal harmonies (often multi-tracked) create rich, layered textures — a signature sound built through studio overdubbing and arrangement. | Key Fact: Brian May's guitar tone uses a homemade guitar (the Red Special) with a coin as a plectrum and heavy amplification, creating a unique orchestral quality. | Key Fact: Love of My Life is a piano ballad with classical influences: arpeggiated accompaniment, chromatic harmony, and Mercury's expressive legato vocal line.
